meta.title: SourceFolio — from open source to opportunity
meta.description: Turn your public open source contributions into a profile recruiters can read and trust. For every tech profile.

profile.metaDescription: What {name} has built in open source: regularity, contributions, languages and projects, every figure checkable on GitHub.

auth.permission: Access to your public profile only.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address leads to no profile. It may have changed or been removed.

account.deleteLead: Deletes your account, your profile and your profile answers. It is immediate and final.
account.deleteFailed: Your account could not be deleted. Try again.

deleteDialog.title: Delete your account?
deleteDialog.description: Your account, your profile and your profile answers are deleted right away. This cannot be undone.

og.lead: Your public contributions, in one profile recruiters can read and verify.

myProfile.title: My profile
myProfile.visitorTitle: Your public contributions already say what you can do.
myProfile.visitorLead: Sign in with GitHub: we read your public data and you see your profile privately. Nothing is published without your consent.
myProfile.analysingLead: Repositories, contributions, languages and pull requests merged elsewhere. A few seconds.
myProfile.failedTitle: GitHub does not recognise this account right now.
myProfile.failedLead: Try again in a moment. If your GitHub username changed, sign in again.
myProfile.readyLead: A few details are left that only you can give.
myProfile.countryHint: Decides which rankings you appear in.
myProfile.cityHint: Only used to place a point on the map. Never your exact location.
myProfile.linkedInHint: Only the link to your profile. We read nothing on LinkedIn.
myProfile.privateLead: Only you can see it. It appears in no ranking and not on the map.
myProfile.publicLead: Visible to everyone, in the rankings and on the map.
myProfile.needCountry: Pick your country to be able to publish.
myProfile.shownNotRanked: City, bio and LinkedIn are shown but never enter a ranking.

rankings.title: Rankings
rankings.lead: Pick a criterion, filter by country and language. Each ranking says exactly what it measures, nothing more.

measures.regularity: Active months out of the last 12, then public contributions.
measures.contributions: Public contributions over the last 12 months.
measures.stars: Stars received on owned public repositories.
measures.external: Pull requests merged in other people's projects.
measures.seniority: GitHub account creation date, oldest first.

rankings.count: {count, plural, =0 {No profiles} one {# profile} other {# profiles}}
rankings.emptyLead: Rankings fill up as tech profiles publish theirs.
rankings.unavailable: The ranking is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
rankings.honest: A ranking measures public open source contribution, not a person's worth.

map.title: The map
map.lead: Each square shows how many profiles are published in an African city. Tap a city to see the rankings of its country.
map.picture: Mosaic of Africa: {count, plural, =0 {no published profile yet} one {# published profile} other {# published profiles}}.
map.count: {count, plural, =0 {No published profile yet} one {# published profile} other {# published profiles}}
map.emptyLead: The map fills up with each published profile. Yours can light your city's first square.
map.unplaced: {count, plural, one {# profile has no city placed on the map.} other {# profiles have no city placed on the map.}}
map.tapHint: Each member gives their own city. It places a profile on the map and never enters a ranking.
map.unavailable: The map cannot be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.

hero.title: From open source to opportunity.
hero.lead: Your public contributions become a profile recruiters can read and verify. Developer, sysadmin, DevOps, data, mobile, QA, security: every tech profile belongs here.

form.invalid: This is not a valid GitHub username.
form.missing: No profile under this name yet.
form.failed: We cannot check right now. Try again in a moment.

map.picture: Mosaic of Africa: each square shows a city's published profiles.

problem.title: A CV tells. Your code shows.
problem.body: Many tech profiles build in public without anyone noticing, and recruiters have no time to read repositories. The profile turns that work into plain facts anyone can check.

profile.title: A profile where every figure has its proof.
profile.lead: Six indicators read from your public GitHub data. Every figure links to the GitHub page that shows it. Nothing is public until you choose to publish.
profile.contributions: {count, plural, one {{formatted} public contribution} other {{formatted} public contributions}}

path.title: An empty calendar is a starting point.
path.lead: Your profile exists from your first contribution. No points, no streaks to keep.

find.title: Find a project
find.body: A tool you already use, documentation to improve.

first.title: Offer a first contribution
first.body: A clear issue, a small pull request.

accepted.title: Get it accepted
accepted.body: Each contribution accepted elsewhere shows on your profile.

publish.title: Publish your profile
publish.body: You decide when it goes public, and you can take it down at any time.

recruit.title: Hiring?
recruit.body: Discover talent by what they have actually built, and join the waitlist for recruiter access.

method.title: The method

reads.contributions: Your public contributions over the last 12 months
reads.seniority: The creation date of your GitHub account
reads.stars: The stars of your public repositories and your followers
reads.languages: The languages of your public repositories
reads.external: Your pull requests accepted in other people's projects

notReads.linkedin: LinkedIn: we only show the link you give
notReads.strangers: People who have not signed up
notReads.score: No overall score: each ranking sorts on one criterion

method.honest: The profile measures public open source contribution, not a person's worth. An excellent engineer working on private code may look quiet here.

hero.title: Stop reading CVs.
hero.lead: Find tech profiles by what they have actually built. Every figure links to its proof on GitHub.

waitlist.title: Recruiter access: coming soon
waitlist.lead: Access is not open yet. Leave your work email and we will write as soon as it is.
waitlist.consent: I agree that SourceFolio keeps this email to contact me about recruiter access. I can remove it at any time, below.
waitlist.done: Noted. We will write as soon as access opens.
waitlist.failed: The sign-up did not go through. Try again in a moment.

leave.summary: Remove my email from the list
leave.done: Done: this address is no longer on the list.
leave.failed: The removal did not go through. Try again in a moment.

field.title: The talent field
field.lead: One square per published profile, darker as the contribution rhythm gets steadier. Open a square to read the profile.
field.empty: The field fills up with each published profile. None is online yet.
field.unavailable: The talent field cannot be loaded right now. Try again in a moment.
field.honest: These profiles measure public open source contribution, not a person's total worth. Work on private code does not show here.
